summary.text: Forrest Mandeville is a Republican state senator who represents Montana State Senate District 28, has served in the Senate since 2023 after representing House District 57 from 2015 to 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A county planner by profession, he chairs the Senate Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Forrest Mandeville was born in and lives in Columbus, Montana, and graduated from Columbus High School in 2002.
He earned a bachelor's degree in history and political science from Point Loma Nazarene University in 2006 and a graduate degree from Montana State University-Billings in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a planner in Stillwater County and at Engineering West, and he also owns his own business.
Mandeville served in the Montana House from 2015 to 2021 before joining the State Senate.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Senate Local Government Committee and served on the Education and Cultural Resources and Finance and Claims committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Kelly Hale in the general election.
